data.narrative:
eGenesis, a Series C-stage biotech company founded by Luhan Yang and George Church, has raised $250M+ to date. Valuation assessment draws on a universe of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in Biotech & Health, with closest stage matches being Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B), and New Limit ($3.1B).

Two valuation methods were applicable. Stage-progression, using total raised ($250M) as a proxy baseline and applying a 1.7x Series C step-up multiplier, implies $425M. Peer-median triangulation across the three same-sector, same-stage comparables yields $3.8B, with a range spanning $3.1B to $10.3B. Public comps anchoring via P/S multiple (median 7.4x across biotech sector) could not be applied due to absence of target revenue disclosure, typical for private companies.

The triangulated valuation range is $361M (low) to $4.4B (high), with a median of $2.1B across both applicable methods. The wide dispersion reflects material uncertainty around stage-appropriate valuation multiples in frontier biotech, particularly given the outsized valuations of Colossal Biosciences relative to peer median. Resolution of this range would benefit from clarity on clinical/technical milestones, capital efficiency metrics, and the positioning of eGenesis within the competitive set on risk profile and clinical stage advancement.
